source: gold_commercial.gold_orders_verified_monthly (Aurora, refreshed daily) for order volume · Orders Verified Data.xlsx for live date / months to launch

orders_data_quality.annual_totals: reliable — agrees with the xlsx within 0.3% on order counts and 2% on dollars
orders_data_quality.monthly_before_2026: EVEN SPREAD of the annual figure (monthly_is_even_spread=true); sums correctly by year, but is not a monthly trend
orders_data_quality.order_counts_carried_forward: months where counts repeat the prior month verbatim are flagged orders_carried_forward
orders_data_quality.current_year_order_count: suppressed — the year has month gaps; use monthly_verified
orders_data_quality.usd_pending: a month with orders but no dollars is not yet aggregated, not zero revenue
orders_data_quality.still_overridden: orders_value_overrides.json still applies — the Rehau 2018 corruption ($102.88M vs a real $3.49M) is present in Aurora too

comment: Per-customer verified order data. Three signals captured: (1) per-year order counts + USD totals (from Raw Data), (2) MONTHLY AVERAGE revenue by year (from Monthly Average sheet — used for apples-to-apples YoY trend since 2026 is partial), (3) Live Date (year customer went live) + Months to Launch (from Month to Month Veified Raw Data sheet — answers Launch Status without HubSpot note scanning).
